people.age: adult ministry, approximately thirty; no extra aging between parallel accounts
people.traits: brown complexion; dark natural curls; full beard; angular nose; lean adult build
people.result: Fresh native-size review of all Mark portraits and Matthew anchors: compatible brown face, prominent nose, full dark beard, natural dark curls, lean build and adult age across parallel events. Light and pose change; no decades of aging.

people.name: John the Baptist
people.traits: brown complexion, full curly beard, natural dark curls, sturdy lean build
people.result: Actual Matthew and Mark baptism files compared side by side at native size. Same coarse-garment adult man with brown face, dark natural curls and full beard; distinct from Jesus, apostle John, Moses, Elijah and Elisha.

people.name: Peter and disciples
people.age: adult ministry; same approximate ages across parallel accounts
people.traits: Peter in two explicitly titled Mark scenes has brown complexion, naturally curled dark hair, full beard and sturdy adult build; unnamed disciples remain varied ancient Near Eastern adults
people.result: Fresh native-size calling and confession/courtyard comparisons retain compatible varied brown faces, dark natural curls and adult builds; Peter has full dark beard and sturdy build across explicitly identified scenes. No exhaustive named-face map or exact count inferred from partial/occluded supper/calling groups.

people.name: Mary, Joseph and women at tomb
people.result: Three Mark tomb women have brown complexions and naturally curled dark hair, varied adult faces/builds. Mark 16:1 names Mary Magdalene, Mary mother of James, Salome; exact face assignment unestablished. No infant/young-Jesus or Joseph portrayal in Mark; birth Mary must not be conflated with Mary Magdalene.

people.name: Paul/Saul, Barnabas, Stephen
people.result: No Mark portrayal or new asset; later Acts current-main candidates cannot become Mark identities. No dependence on parallel work.

people.name: Moses and Elijah
people.result: Mark 8 Story is confession; Mark 9 is a bright cloud, with no identifiable Moses/Elijah. No inherited Moses/Elijah reference is newly reapproved. Never use inactive Matthew Transfiguration v1.
